2607.29657.title: Development of FDD-ON: an Ontology for VAV HVAC System Fault Detection and Diagnostics
2607.29657.paper_summary: Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) technology is essential for improving HVAC system reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness. However, effective deployment of FDD solutions in buildings requires structured domain knowledge that can bridge heterogeneous data sources, diverse equipment types, and varied diagnostic outputs. Limited data interpretability and interoperability within the FDD domain have led to fragmented information silos, hindering the implementation of FDD and related applications, such as the digital twin-enabled FDD frameworks and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven maintenance decision-making systems. This paper presents an FDD Ontology (FDD-ON), a modular and extensible ontology to formally represent variable air volume (VAV) HVAC system components, fault types, symptom statuses, fault impacts and associated attributes. FDD-ON integrates HVAC system FDD semantics to provide comprehensive representations of fault and symptom attributes, supported by the well-defined controlled vocabulary. Additionally, FDD-ON offers comprehensive fault, symptom, and impact libraries to capture a broad spectrum of operational abnormalities and their consequences in VAV HVAC systems. Through explicit contributing cause-fault-symptom-impact relations, FDD-ON serves as a machine-interpretable basis for querying diagnostic knowledge, mapping heterogeneous FDD outputs, and developing interoperable FDD-related applications. FDD-ON is evaluated using publicly available VAV HVAC system datasets and demonstrated through FDD development applications. Results indicate that FDD-ON provides a foundational semantic framework for advancing scalable, transparent, and interoperable FDD solutions across various applications.
2607.29657.paper_summary_zh: 故障檢測與診斷（FDD）技術對於提高 HVAC 系統的可靠性、能源效率和維護效能至關重要。<lb/>然而，在建築中有效部署 FDD 解決方案需要結構化的領域知識，以便能夠橋接異質數據來源、多樣化的設備類型和各種診斷輸出。<lb/>在 FDD 領域內，有限的數據可解釋性和互操作性導致了信息孤島的碎片化，妨礙了 FDD 及相關應用的實施，例如數位雙胞胎支持的 FDD 框架和人工智慧（AI）驅動的維護決策系統。<lb/>本文提出了一個 FDD 本體（FDD-ON），這是一個模組化和可擴展的本體，用於正式表示變風量（VAV）HVAC 系統組件、故障類型、症狀狀態、故障影響及相關屬性。<lb/>FDD-ON 整合了 HVAC 系統 FDD 語義，以提供故障和症狀屬性的全面表示，並由明確定義的控制詞彙支持。<lb/>此外，FDD-ON 提供全面的故障、症狀和影響庫，以捕捉 VAV HVAC 系統中各種操作異常及其後果。<lb/>通過明確的成因-故障-症狀-影響關係，FDD-ON 作為一個機器可解釋的基礎，用於查詢診斷知識、映射異質 FDD 輸出和開發互操作的 FDD 相關應用。<lb/>FDD-ON 使用公開可用的 VAV HVAC 系統數據集進行評估，並通過 FDD 開發應用進行演示。<lb/>結果表明，FDD-ON 為推進各種應用中的可擴展、透明和互操作的 FDD 解決方案提供了基礎語義框架。
